economy.summary: His official House biography lists reducing unemployment and promoting small business development and economic empowerment across his North Philadelphia district among his legislative priorities.
economy.short: Prioritizes reducing unemployment, small business development, and economic empowerment.

education.summary: Sponsored the Keystone Fresh Act (House Bill 1768), which passed the House and would create a grant program for schools to buy locally sourced foods; he said it would improve student nutrition and connect schools with Pennsylvania farmers.
education.short: Sponsored Keystone Fresh Act to fund local foods in school meals.

healthcare.summary: Introduced House Bill 2121 to let Pennsylvania issue provisional medical licenses to qualified international medical graduates practicing under supervision in underserved areas, saying it would responsibly expand access to care while maintaining patient safety standards.
healthcare.short: Introduced bill to license international medical graduates for underserved areas.

energy.summary: Co-introduced House Bill 2224 to set a formula-based cap on investor-owned utilities' return on equity, saying utilities should earn a fair return but not at the expense of Pennsylvanians struggling to afford their bills.
energy.short: Co-introduced bill to cap utility profits and lower consumer bills.

guns.summary: His official House biography lists criminal justice reform as a focus, including reducing recidivism and creating pathways for former offenders to reintegrate into society; this is a public-safety priority and his page does not detail a firearms-policy position.
guns.short: Lists criminal justice reform, reducing recidivism, as a priority.
